mapper.insert: insert ignore into fin_stock_position (tenant_id, dept_id, product_id, quantity) values (#{tenantId}, #{deptId}, #{productId}, 0)

insert into fin_stock_ledger
tenant_id, dept_id, product_id, product_name, change_type, change_quantity, before_quantity, after_quantity, unit_cost, reference_type, reference_id, reference_no, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark,
#{tenantId}, #{deptId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{changeType}, #{changeQuantity}, #{beforeQuantity}, #{afterQuantity}, #{unitCost}, #{referenceType}, #{referenceId}, #{referenceNo}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark},
mapper.select: select p.dept_id, p.product_id, p.quantity, (select l.product_name from fin_stock_ledger l where l.dept_id = p.dept_id and l.product_id = p.product_id and l.del_flag = '0' order by l.create_time desc limit 1) as product_name from fin_stock_position p where p.dept_id = #{deptId}
mapper.insert: insert into fin_stock_snapshot (snapshot_date, dept_id, dept_name, product_id, product_name, quantity, opening_quantity, in_quantity, out_quantity, unit_cost, total_value) values (#{snapshotDate}, #{deptId}, #{deptName}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{quantity}, #{openingQuantity}, #{inQuantity}, #{outQuantity}, #{unitCost}, #{totalValue}) on duplicate key update quantity = values(quantity), opening_quantity = values(opening_quantity), in_quantity = values(in_quantity), out_quantity = values(out_quantity), dept_name = values(dept_name), product_name = values(product_name), unit_cost = values(unit_cost), total_value = values(total_value)
